name: Regideity
look: a titanic colossus: two immense black-banded white legs from a glowing green orb, a great gold ring with two horns, gems and dark spikes round a dotted white head, two turning halos, and six arms ending in gold cups with white fingers
entry: Legends say it towed the continents into place with its six arms and stood astride the seas while it worked. When it walks, mountains shake as if in an earthquake, and the halos round its ring shine brighter the longer it has been awake.
how: Use a Nether Star on a Regigigas. It learns Meteor Mash when it evolves.
